description: Default checks run on every ticket's page, whether or not the acceptance criteria mention them. Keep page-specific acceptance criteria in each ticket's tests instead.

cases.title: Page loads without browser or first-party request errors
cases.covers: Successful page response, uncaught JavaScript errors, and failed same-origin resources.

cases.title: JS, CSS, font and image assets load
cases.covers: No failed scripts, stylesheets, fonts or images, and no broken images on the page.

cases.title: Third-party scripts load without errors
cases.covers: If applicable: third-party scripts and plugins load and do not throw errors.

cases.title: API requests succeed, are fast and are not duplicated
cases.covers: If applicable: no failed, CORS-blocked or over-10s API requests, and no duplicate GET requests on load.

cases.title: API responses are valid JSON with correct data types
cases.covers: If applicable: JSON parses, numeric fields are numbers (not strings), and record ids are not null.

cases.title: API errors and slow responses show a clear state
cases.covers: If applicable: when data requests are slowed, a loading indicator shows; when they return 500, an error message shows with no uncaught errors or endless spinner. Responses are changed in the browser only; writes are blocked.

cases.title: Protected pages require a session and handle an expired one
cases.covers: If applicable (logged-in runs only): without a session the page redirects to login or denies access and APIs return no records; a 401 from the API leads to login or a session-expired message. Writes are blocked.

cases.title: Shared navigation links have working destinations
cases.covers: Visible navigation links have destinations and same-origin pages respond successfully.

cases.title: Visible links and controls are usable
cases.covers: Interactive controls have accessible names, links have destinations, and keyboard focus can reach controls.

cases.title: Semantic elements and heading hierarchy
cases.covers: Clickable elements are real <button>/<a> (not clickable <div>), one <h1>, and the first heading is the <h1>.

cases.title: Basic page accessibility checks pass
cases.covers: Images have alt attributes and headings follow a sensible order.

cases.title: Keyboard focus is visible and dialogs close with Escape
cases.covers: Tab moves focus with a visible focus indicator; an open dialog closes with Escape.

cases.title: Page has no horizontal overflow at common viewport sizes
cases.covers: The page remains within the viewport at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.

cases.title: Text is not cut off and expected UI renders
cases.covers: No clipped text without an ellipsis, no unrendered values (undefined, NaN, {{ }}), and loading indicators go away after load.

cases.title: Forms show validation without submitting real data
cases.covers: When a form exists, submitting invalid or empty required fields shows validation and does not create records or send messages.

cases.title: Async form actions do not submit twice on a rapid double click
cases.covers: For an available POST form, rapid repeat clicks do not launch duplicate writes. Test requests are blocked before reaching the server.

cases.title: Date and date-range fields reject invalid values
cases.covers: If applicable: leap-day and month-end dates are accepted, a start date later than the end date is rejected, and no "Invalid Date" shows.

cases.title: Email and phone fields reject invalid formats
cases.covers: If applicable: invalid email and phone values are flagged. Writes are blocked in the browser.

cases.title: Tables show a no-data state when their list is empty
cases.covers: When the page has a table, its list requests are emptied in the browser only (no server data is changed) and the table must show an empty-state message.

cases.title: Search, filter, sort and pagination update the list
cases.covers: If applicable: sorting keeps the same data in a new order, a no-match search narrows the list, and the next page shows different rows. Writes are blocked.
